units.lesson: Build a next-token model with explicit tensor shapes, embeddings, logits and cross-entropy; prove the loop can overfit a tiny fixed batch.
units.practice: A minimal forward/backward training loop with deterministic seed and shape assertions.
units.sandbox_task: Train on synthetic token sequences; verify loss falls and gradients are finite.
units.transfer_task: Change sequence length and verify causal behavior remains correct.
units.rubric: Tiny-batch loss reduction; finite gradients; deterministic config; no leakage.
units.benchmark: Fixed tiny-batch overfit and causal-mask suite.

units.lesson: Explain bytes versus tokens, special tokens, packing, truncation, deduplication and split isolation.
units.practice: Build tokenizer round-trip and dataset manifest checks.
units.sandbox_task: Use synthetic text fixtures and test UTF-8 edge cases, padding, truncation and packing.
units.transfer_task: Transfer to a held-out text fixture with Unicode and repeated spans.
units.rubric: Round-trip, no cross-split duplicate, manifest provenance and tokenizer hash.
units.benchmark: Tokenizer contract and dataset quality gate.

units.lesson: Implement causal multi-head attention, positional encoding/RoPE, residuals, normalization and feed-forward layers.
units.practice: Trace shapes and gradients through one transformer block.
units.sandbox_task: Run attention-mask, gradient and tiny-batch overfit tests.
units.transfer_task: Change context length and verify no future-token leakage.
units.rubric: Finite gradients, causal isolation, shape invariants, reproducibility.

units.objective: Efficient attention and mixture of experts
units.lesson: Compare full, linear and sparse attention; explain KV cache, GQA, MoE routing and tied embeddings.
units.practice: Implement one small efficient-attention or MoE component behind a feature flag.
units.sandbox_task: Use deterministic synthetic tensors to test routing and cache invariants.
units.transfer_task: Evaluate on held-out sequence lengths and skewed routing inputs.
units.rubric: Correctness before speed; memory and latency measured; no ungrounded architecture claims.

units.lesson: Compare AdamW baseline with optional Muon experiment; teach warmup, cosine decay, clipping, weight decay, AMP and accumulation.
units.practice: Create a reproducible experiment config and profiler report.
units.sandbox_task: Run CPU-safe microbenchmarks; use GPU only if available and authorized.
units.transfer_task: Repeat with changed batch/accumulation and compare stable metrics.
units.rubric: Seed/config pinned; tokens/sec, peak memory, loss and cost recorded.

units.lesson: Build train/validation/test separation, curriculum/interleaving, checkpoints, perplexity and multi-seed analysis.
units.practice: Create a training manifest and baseline scorecard.
units.sandbox_task: Train only on approved toy or rights-cleared data; inspect generated samples.
units.transfer_task: Evaluate on isolated held-out data and a second seed.
units.rubric: No leakage; checkpoint hash; sample review; uncertainty and baseline reported.

units.lesson: Explain SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, preference optimization and reward loops; identify reward hacking risks.
units.practice: Prepare a rights-cleared synthetic SFT fixture and reward-test harness.
units.sandbox_task: Run a mocked grader; test reward exploitation and shortcut behavior.
units.transfer_task: Transfer to unseen unit-test tasks without training on holdout.
units.rubric: Rights cleared; train/eval split clean; reward robustness measured; no false success claim.
units.benchmark: SFT data validation and reward-hacking suite.

units.lesson: Explain image patches, vision encoders, 2D RoPE and text/image token boundaries.
units.practice: Build a tiny synthetic image-patch encoder exercise.
units.sandbox_task: Use generated geometric images only; test patch count and modality boundaries.
units.rubric: Correct patch dimensions, modality isolation and safety checks.

units.objective: Buddy routing, registry and dataset lineage
units.lesson: Connect model identity, adapter metadata, database source-of-truth, routing permissions and dataset lineage.
units.practice: Define a model-run manifest and a read-only route decision fixture.
units.sandbox_task: Test allowlists, unavailable sources, stale cache and retry/idempotency using mocks.
units.transfer_task: Transfer to a second synthetic provider and schema version.
units.rubric: No unapproved writes; provenance complete; failover and audit decisions inspectable.
units.benchmark: Registry schema, routing and lineage contract tests.

units.lesson: Evaluate repeatability, holdout transfer, regression, safety, latency, throughput, memory and cost.
units.practice: Produce a complete model card and evidence packet.
units.sandbox_task: Run pinned suite and adversarial fixtures in isolated sandbox.
units.transfer_task: Independent reviewer reruns the suite from recorded artifacts.
units.rubric: Repeat pass, held-out transfer, no regression, fresh evidence and explicit limitations.
